Quick question--in the wiki article about Egwene al'Vere, it says that she is very short, standing one span and three inches. However, to the best of my knowledge and research, a span is 6 feet. Should this be revised?

[[Special:Contributions/24.151.236.94|24.151.236.94]] 00:39, May 22, 2012 (UTC)

No, it shouldn't be revised. One span, two inches equals sixty-two inches in Randland [[measurement]]. Converted to real-world measurement, she's about 5'2". ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 01:39, May 22, 2012 (UTC)
